You reach toward your companion and breathe out slowly. Warmth passes into their wounds while the effort catches painfully in your chest.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One willing creature within 3 squares, including self
Duration
Instant
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Moser’s law of conservation of Life energy: pay 1 HP before rolling; bypass resistance and remain above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Life resistance reduces restoration, minimum 1 where HP is missing. Healing-harmed creatures take the rolled result as Life damage. No resurrection or removal of wounds/Grit loss.

Weak
Restore 3 HP.
Standard
Restore 6 HP.
Strong
Restore 9 HP.

Additional rulings

Offensive healing — latest agreement: this spell may target an unwilling creature harmed by healing. Resolve it as an attack using its printed attribute, range, action and HP cost; the HP result becomes Life damage, without beneficial recovery riders. This is the explicit exception to willing-only targeting above. Use the creature’s printed defense when a player defends; no opposed second roll.
